controls: Deterministic SplitMix64 Fisher-Yates permutations. Select distinct nonidentity permutations. Equal blocks use round(duration/120). Record each selected seed.
spatial_coverage: Keep the best score at every evaluated grid position before pruning the candidate list.
status: insufficient_evidence if support or control checks fail; ambiguous if competitive evaluated positions are over 1 km apart; candidates_found otherwise.
limitations: The screens were developed after the development-case results. The new E/F clips remain unused until the integrated binary is frozen. Success is a model status, not a calibrated probability or guaranteed radius.
